name: School Days
source:
This game has 3 fun stories in a school. In story 1, a guy follow his teacher and learn some interesting lessons. In story 2, a guy help a girl gain confidence and love. Story 3 has a nurse playing with a female student.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
translation:
这款游戏在学校里讲述三个有趣的故事。故事1中，一个男孩跟踪老师，学到了有趣的课程。故事2中，一个男孩帮助女孩建立自信并找到爱情。故事3中，一名护士和女学生玩耍。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160403171040/http://members.shaw.ca:80/lisun/jhag-wns.htm]Li's Fun House[/url]]
